voice.name: Open Sector - Medic
voice.description: Young female field medic in her mid twenties, warm but brisk and no-nonsense, clear bright voice with a slight country accent, calm under fire like she has seen it all, a little bossy with patients and fiercely protective, speaks quickly with gentle authority.
voice.sample: Medic here, hold still and stop whining, it's just a scratch. I'll have you patched up and back on your feet before the next shell lands. Breathe, soldier, I've got you.

ready: Medic, ready to patch you up.

move.prompt: Soldier jogging on dirt with a medical satchel bouncing and canteen rattling, short burst of footsteps, close, no music, no voice

special.prompt: Field medic at work: canvas medical bag unzipped, bandage roll unwrapped and torn, gauze ripped, glass vial clink, close up, no music, no voice
